_meta.about: Texts of the Sysbox dashboard tile (RAM, storage, CPU, GPU, wall power, containers), its settings page and the Snapshots, Safe shutdown and Update manager pages (Settings, Utilities), and the Claude button in the Unraid header. The Discord messages and the technical logs are not here. Product and Unraid names (Sysbox, Unraid, Docker, ZFS, Main, Shares, Mover, Quick Sync, Shelly, Claude, qBittorrent) follow Unraid's own translation or stay as they are.

set.help_tile.text: Sysbox replaces the System and Processor tiles (hide them in the dashboard's tile management) and, when switched on, takes over the server load of the Streambox tile. The container buttons use the Docker command line with the exact name of an existing container; nothing else can be started from the dashboard. Statistics, GPU and socket readings are collected in the background only while the dashboard is open. The monthly energy figure is the socket's own counter since the 1st of the month, and a small cron job keeps it exact even when nobody has the dashboard open.
set.help_tile.note: grey paragraph at the bottom of the settings page.

set.help_discord.text: Discord alerts: Unraid checks every minute and posts to the webhook only when something changes: a problem appears, gets worse, or is over. A container that stops with a normal exit (code 0 or a plain stop) or through the dashboard button is not reported; one that crashes, is killed or runs out of memory is. Memory, CPU temperature and unhealthy checks must last a few minutes before they are reported, and a restart loop means three restarts within ten minutes. Red alerts can repeat after the chosen number of hours. The buttons use the saved settings, so press Apply first. Create a webhook in Discord under channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks.

snp.intro.text: A ZFS snapshot freezes a dataset as it is: it costs almost no space at first and grows only with the changes. A daily one before the container updates lets you bring back any container's data from the last days. The whole dataset is never rolled back; a single container can be restored, with a safety snapshot first.

sd.intro.text: Stops the containers (qBittorrent first, with up to 5 minutes to close its files) and the VMs, shows every process that still uses the array or pool disks, then calls Unraid's own shutdown or restart, the same as the buttons on the Main page. Nothing is stopped until you press a button.

sd.s3.text: Every process that has a file open on the array or pool disks. Ask to quit sends TERM, so the program can save and close its files; Force quit sends KILL, only for what does not quit (unsaved data of that program is lost). What Unraid stops by itself (Samba, Docker, the VM manager) or what runs inside a container is not offered.

upm.g.amber.text: New features, a fresh release, warning words or no version label

upm.g.green.text: Image rebuild or patch: the program barely changes

upm.g.current.note: title of the group of current containers.

upm.none_l.note: text in an empty list. Short.

upm.local.text: built on this server: nothing to compare with
upm.local.note: why a container cannot be checked.

upm.g.other.note: title of the group of containers that cannot be checked.

upm.n_ctr.note: grey text on the right of the Docker containers band.

upm.n_upd.note: grey text on the right of a band.

upm.todo_saved.text: saved as a to-do {t} (updates_todo.md: Claude moves it into the task list)
upm.todo_saved.note: grey text under a Claude answer that was saved ({t} like "2 h ago").

upm.todo_btn.note: small button under a Claude answer.

upm.todo_hint.text: the Sysbox writes it to updates_todo.md in the repo; the next Claude session moves it into the task list

upm.for_version.note: header of a Claude answer ({t} like "2 h ago").

upm.source.note: link next to "What changed" (the release notes page).

upm.not_asked.text: Claude has not been asked about this version.
upm.not_asked.note: grey text next to the notes.

upm.ask_reads.text: Ask Claude reads these notes and our code that uses the program (read-only).

upm.c.title.note: start of the confirmation row of an update (bold), followed by "old → new?".

upm.c.s1_snap.text: 1) a ZFS snapshot of its data (restore it on the Snapshots page if needed),
upm.c.s1_snap.note: first step in the confirmation row.

upm.c.s1_nosnap.note: first step when the snapshot is switched off.

upm.c.s2_qb.text: 2) stop it (up to 5 minutes, qBittorrent saves its torrents' state),

upm.c.s3.text: 3) Unraid pulls the new image and recreates it from its template,

upm.c.s4_test.text: 4) start it again and run the self-test.

upm.c.red.text: This one is red: read Changes first.
upm.c.red.note: red warning in the confirmation row.

upm.c.amber.text: This one is amber: read Changes first.
upm.c.amber.note: amber warning in the confirmation row.

upm.c.moving.text: qBittorrent is moving {n} torrent(s) now (at the last self-test): the move is interrupted.
upm.c.moving.note: amber warning when qBittorrent is moving data.

os.released.note: grey line under the new Unraid version ({d} release date, {t} like "3 h ago").

os.php.note: amber chip: the new Unraid has a new PHP version.

os.reboot.note: small text under the OS update.

os.notes.note: small button of the OS update.

os.page.note: link to Unraid's Tools, Update OS page.

os.not_here.text: The OS is not installed from here. Before it: no parity check running, qBittorrent stopped (Safe shutdown).
os.not_here.note: grey note under the OS update. Safe shutdown is the Sysbox page.

os.current.text: no newer version at Unraid's last check, {t}
os.current.note: text when the OS is current ({t} like "3 h ago").

os.never.text: Unraid has not checked for an OS update yet (Tools, Update OS, Check)
os.never.note: text before Unraid's first OS check. Tools, Update OS, Check are Unraid's words.

pl.ours.note: chip after one of our plugins ({n} its name).

pl.update.note: state of a plugin with a newer version. Short.

pl.n_upd.one: {n} plugin update (install them on the Plugins page; ours with their .plg)
pl.n_upd.other: {n} plugin updates (install them on the Plugins page; ours with their .plg)

pl.current.text: Up to date at Unraid's last plugin check

test.lead.text: Read-only checks of our connections: logins and GET requests. It runs by itself after an update; Discord gets the result.
test.lead.note: lead line of the Self-test part.

test.testing.note: the self-test button while it runs.

test.for.note: grey line under a test: which of our plugins use the connection ({w} plugin names).

test.band.note: grey text on the right of the Self-test band ({t} like "2 h ago").

test.not_run.note: grey text on the right of the Self-test band.

set.on.note: text next to a checkbox. Short.

set.at.note: word before the hour field ("on at 04 : 30").

set.daily_hint.text: only reads (registries, GitHub). Nothing is installed by itself

set.soak.note: label of a setting: how old a release must be before it counts as safe.

set.soak_hint.text: a new-features release younger than this is amber, even without warning words

set.dc_warn.note: choice: which new updates go to Discord.

set.dc_hint.text: after the daily check, once per update (the Sysbox webhook); updates you start always report their result

set.bk.text: ZFS snapshot of the container's data

set.bk_hint.text: the snapshot is named before-update-<name>-<date> and stays until you delete it on the Snapshots page
set.bk_hint.note: hint. Keep before-update-<name>-<date> as it is.

set.cl_ro.note: purple chip. Read and Grep are tool names: keep them.

set.cl_hint.text: Claude Code in the claude container, in the repo folder, without a saved session; it never runs commands or writes. The answer is kept per version. A new Unraid OS version is asked about by itself after a check, once

cl.starting.note: text of the new browser tab while the Claude button starts the session ({host} the server name).

cl.failed.note: text of the new tab when it failed.

cl.base.note: first line of the tooltip of the Claude button in the Unraid header.

cl.just_now.note: in the tooltip: when the usage was last read.

cl.dh.note: a time span in the tooltip.

cl.hm.note: a time span in the tooltip.

cl.m.note: a time span in the tooltip.

cl.dow.sun.note: short day name in the tooltip (when the weekly limit resets).

cl.dow.mon.note: short day name in the tooltip (when the weekly limit resets).

cl.dow.tue.note: short day name in the tooltip (when the weekly limit resets).

cl.dow.wed.note: short day name in the tooltip (when the weekly limit resets).

cl.dow.thu.note: short day name in the tooltip (when the weekly limit resets).

cl.dow.fri.note: short day name in the tooltip (when the weekly limit resets).

cl.dow.sat.note: short day name in the tooltip (when the weekly limit resets).

cl.no_usage.note: second line of the tooltip when no usage data exists.

cl.week_new.text: Week:     new week since {t}, no data yet
cl.week_new.note: tooltip line. The spaces after the colon line the values up in a monospace tooltip: keep the label and the spaces about as long.

cl.week.note: tooltip line: the weekly plan usage.

cl.from_tomorrow.note: value of the Today line before a full day of data.

cl.e_nodata.text: no usage data yet (the status line writes it while Claude Code works)

cl.e_docker.text: Docker is not running (is the array started?)

cl.e_tmux.text: Could not start the tmux session in the container.

ue.bad_name.note: error on the Update manager page.

ue.scan_busy.note: error on the Update manager page.

ue.test_busy.note: error on the Update manager page.

ue.claude_off.text: Ask Claude is switched off in the settings
ue.claude_off.note: error on the Update manager page.

ue.claude_busy.text: Claude is already answering another question
ue.claude_busy.note: error on the Update manager page.

ue.claude_ct.text: the claude container is built here; it is not updated from a registry
ue.claude_ct.note: error on the Update manager page.

ue.upd_busy.text: another update is running, try again when it has finished
ue.upd_busy.note: error on the Update manager page.

ue.no_update.note: error on the Update manager page.

uj.check_failed.note: Activity row of a failed update check.

uj.summary.note: result of an update check in Activity.

uj.current.note: result of an update check in Activity.

uj.checked.note: Activity row of a finished check.

uj.checked_one.note: Activity row of a finished check of one container.

uj.selftest.note: Activity row of a finished self-test.

uj.failed_list.note: added to the self-test row: which tests failed (in capitals on purpose).

uj.updating.note: Activity row while a container is updated.

ut.ab_nokey.text: connected (no API key in Seedbox Tools: the IRC feed is not checked)

ut.ab_irc.text: connected, but the IRC state could not be read ({e})

ut.unreachable.note: in a self-test result: the service does not answer.

ut.ab_nonet.text: connected, but no IRC network is enabled: no live feed

ut.ab_bad.note: self-test result of autobrr ({l} what is wrong).

ut.ab_last.note: added to it ({t} like 12 min, {ch} the IRC channel).

gd.dc_more.text: Full report: Settings → Utilities → Claude Guard
gd.dc_more.note: last line of the Claude Guard Discord message.

gd.dc_title_err.note: Discord title when Claude did not answer.

gd.dc_title_event.note: Discord title of a report about an alert.

gd.dc_title_skip.note: Discord title when the weekly limit stopped the report.

gd.e_busy.text: Claude is already writing a report
gd.e_busy.note: error on the Claude Guard page.

gd.e_noct.text: The claude container was not found (Claude Code in Docker is needed)
gd.e_noct.note: error and report text when the container is missing.

gd.j_err.note: Activity text of a failed report.

gd.j_fine.note: Activity text of a report with no finding.

gd.j_look.note: Activity text: number of amber and red findings.

gd.j_todo.text: {n} saved as a to-do for Claude Code
gd.j_todo.note: Activity text: findings written to guard_todo.md.

gd.job_event.note: Activity row title; {t} is the start of the alert text.

gd.n_look.note: Discord title part: number of amber and red findings.

gd.skip_limit.text: Skipped: the weekly Claude limit is at {p} % (the setting is {l} %). The snapshot was saved.
gd.skip_limit.note: report text when the weekly limit stopped it.

gdm.ev_band.note: right side of the Event reports band.

gdm.h.latest_n.note: band title with the number of findings.

gdm.h.settings_sub.text: Claude only reads; it cannot run commands or change anything
gdm.h.settings_sub.note: right side of the Settings band.

gdm.intro.text: Claude Code (in the claude container) reads a snapshot of the server every day and after alerts, and tells you what needs a look. It only reads: what to do stays your click.

gdm.kept.note: right side of the Earlier reports band.

gdm.n_fin.note: right side of the Activity band.

gdm.n_running.note: right side of the Activity band.

gdm.night.text: {n} alert(s) wait for the next daily report (quiet hours or the daily limit)

gdm.no_ct.text: Claude Guard needs Claude Code running in a Docker container named claude (see docker/claude-code in the repository). Without it nothing runs here.
gdm.no_ct.note: shown instead of the report when the container is missing.

gdm.no_events.text: No alert reports in the last 7 days.

gdm.no_report.text: No report yet. The first daily report comes at {t}, or start one now.
gdm.no_report.note: empty state of the latest report.

gdm.noise.note: foldable bar: log lines Claude found harmless.

gdm.nothing_run.text: Nothing has run in the last day.

gdm.off.text: Claude Guard is off. Switch it on in the settings below.
gdm.off.note: shown when the Guard is off.

gdm.running.note: main button while a report runs.

gdm.select.note: when copying is not allowed by the browser.

gdm.took.note: status strip: how long the report took.

gdm.week_count.note: right side of a week bar.

gds.a_day.note: settings: after the number of event reports.

gds.at_most.note: settings: before the number of event reports.

gds.daily_hint.text: A snapshot is taken at this time every day and compared with the previous one.

gds.dc_hint.text: Sent to the Sysbox webhook. Nothing is sent in quiet hours.

gds.dc_issues.text: Only when something is amber or red

gds.events_hint.text: Amber and red alerts start a report. In quiet hours, or above the daily limit, they go into the next daily report.

gds.from.note: settings: before the start hour of the quiet hours (may be empty in other languages).

gds.hours.note: settings: after the end hour of the quiet hours.

gds.limit_hint.text: A skipped report is noted here and in Discord; the snapshot is still saved. Run a report now ignores the limit.

gds.on_hint.text: Needs Claude Code in the claude container, signed in.

gds.quiet_hint.text: Nothing runs and nothing is sent between these hours; alerts wait for the morning report.

gds.to.note: settings: between the two hours of the quiet hours.

gds.todo.text: Save amber and red findings for Claude Code

gds.todo_hint.text: They are appended to guard_todo.md in the repository; the next Claude Code session moves them into its task list.

gds.topics_hint.text: API keys, passwords and webhook addresses never go into the snapshot. Titles and file names do.

topic.containers.note: topic of a finding; also a settings checkbox.

topic.disks.note: topic of a finding; also a settings checkbox.

topic.logs.note: topic of a finding; also a settings checkbox.

topic.services.note: topic of a finding; also a settings checkbox.
